name: Deep Research
description: Autonomous web deep-research: search → read → reason → cited answer. Adds the /research command and a deep_research agent tool.
author: cognia-next

networkAccess.reasoning: The research loop reads pages the web search returns, so the hosts are only known at runtime. Every request goes through the host's own web_fetch — this plugin holds no keys and opens no sockets of its own.

permissionJustifications.agent:control: Calls the app's own web_search and web_fetch tools so research reuses your configured search providers, result cache and safety guards instead of shipping a second, weaker copy.
permissionJustifications.ai:chat: Drives the research loop with your configured model: rewriting queries, judging sources, and drafting the final cited answer.
permissionJustifications.ai:embed: Deduplicates near-identical search results and evidence so the loop spends its budget on genuinely new sources.
permissionJustifications.artifact:write: Saves a finished report as a versioned, exportable workspace artifact so it survives beyond the chat message.
permissionJustifications.settings:read: Reads this plugin's own research budgets (token budget, step ceiling, sources per read, answer locale).

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Run an autonomous web research loop (search → read → reason → cited answer) for a multi-hop or knowledge-intensive question. mode='search' returns a grounded cited answer; mode='report' returns a multi-section cited report. Use for questions that need current web evidence.

query.description: The research question or report topic.

mode.description: 'search' for a cited answer (default), 'report' for a multi-section report.

commands.name: /research
commands.description: Autonomous web deep-research → a cited answer.

tokenBudget.title: Token budget
tokenBudget.description: Soft cap; past this the loop forces a best-effort answer.

maxBadAttempts.title: Max failed answers
maxBadAttempts.description: How many rejected answer attempts before the loop settles for its best effort.

readTopK.title: Sources per read
readTopK.description: How many pages to read per read step.

searchResultsPerQuery.title: Results per query
searchResultsPerQuery.description: How many search results to request for each query.

locale.title: Answer locale
locale.description: BCP-47 locale to bias query rewriting + the final answer (e.g. zh-CN).

en.manifest.name: Deep Research
en.manifest.description: Autonomous web deep-research: search → read → reason → cited answer. Adds the /research command and a deep_research agent tool.
en.slash.usage:
Usage:
- `/research <question>` — a cited answer.
- `/research report <topic>` — a multi-section cited report.
- Prefix with `quick` or `deep` to shrink or raise the research budget (e.g. `/research deep report <topic>`).
en.card.title: Deep Research
en.card.noteBudget: ⚠️ answered under budget limits — may be incomplete
en.report.footerPartial: {sections} sections · {tokens} tokens · deep research report · ⚠️ partial
en.error.noProvider:
**Deep Research** needs an AI model provider.

No model is configured for this plugin to use. Configure a provider in settings, then try again.
en.error.noAiPermission:
**Deep Research** needs permission to use the AI model.

The research loop calls the model to rewrite queries, judge sources, and draft the answer. Grant the model access when prompted, then try again.
en.error.webDisabled:
**Deep Research** is disabled because web tools are turned off.

Enable web tools in Settings, then try again.
en.error.noSearchProvider:
**Deep Research** needs a web search provider.

Enable one and add its API key in Settings → Search, then try again.
en.error.rateLimited:
**Deep Research** hit the outbound rate limit.

Too many web requests in a short window. Wait a moment, then try again.
en.error.blocked:
**Deep Research** was blocked by a safety guard.

The request contained sensitive data, or targeted an address the app refuses to fetch.
en.error.toolUnavailable: **Deep Research** cannot reach the app's web tools on this host.
en.answer.cancelledWithFindings:
Research was cancelled. Findings gathered so far:

{findings}
en.answer.cancelledEmpty: Research was cancelled before an answer could be drafted.
en.report.cancelledEmpty: Research was cancelled before any section completed.
en.commands.research.description: Autonomous web deep-research → a cited answer.
